findings.evidence: Line 51 imposes `[FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]`; Mathlib/FieldTheory/Galois/Infinite.lean:85 provides `InfiniteGalois.fixedField_fixingSubgroup (L) [IsGalois k K]` without finite dimensionality, and this file already imports `TauCeti.FieldTheory.Galois.FixedField`, which imports that module.
findings.fix: Drop the finite-dimensional assumption, use `InfiniteGalois.fixedField_fixingSubgroup` for injectivity of the fixing-subgroup map, and construct the inverse on the conjugacy orbit using its conjugate representative (or closed-subgroup correspondence) instead of `IntermediateField.fixingSubgroup_fixedField` for an arbitrary subgroup.
findings.issue: The section-wide `[FiniteDimensional K L]` unnecessarily restricts `stabilizer_eq_normalizer_fixingSubgroup` and all derived orbit, quotient, and cardinal declarations; these statements remain natural for arbitrary `[IsGalois K L]`.

summary: The generic conjugate-field API is unnecessarily restricted to finite-dimensional Galois extensions, although the relevant Galois correspondence direction holds for arbitrary Galois extensions.
